notes.title: Freshman Cake Race
notes.text: Homecoming morning, before sunrise, freshmen run half a mile and finish on top of Freshman Hill by Bobby Dodd. Everybody gets cupcakes, the winners get actual cakes. Not required anymore, but they really want you there.
notes.tip: Ramblin' Reck Club bakes the cupcakes the night before.

notes.title: Mini 500
notes.text: Tricycle race around Peters Parking Deck, Friday afternoon before the Homecoming game. Teams of seven: four drivers, three pit crew. Running since 1969, run by Ramblin' Reck Club.
notes.tip: Go watch at least once. It's chaotic in the best way.

notes.title: The Ramblin' Reck
notes.text: A 1930 Ford Model A that leads the football team onto the field at every home game, since Sept. 30, 1961. Cared for by Ramblin' Reck Club and an elected Reck Driver.
notes.tip: Home game days: look for it at Bobby Dodd.
